description: This file defines functions for manipulating and analyzing Bezier curves, including intersection, length calculation, offsetting, and tangent computation. It is part of a math package within a larger project.

methods.name: curve
methods.description: Creates a Bezier curve from four points.

methods.name: solveWithAnalyticalJacobian
methods.description: Solves for intersection parameters between a Bezier curve and a line segment using Newton's method.

methods.name: bezierEquation
methods.description: Calculates a point on a Bezier curve at parameter t.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Computes intersection point between a cubic spline and a line segment.

methods.name: curveIntersectLineSegment
methods.description: Finds intersection points between a cubic spline and a line segment.

methods.name: curveClosestPoint
methods.description: Finds the closest point on a Bezier curve to a given point.

methods.name: curvePointDistance
methods.description: Calculates distance from a point to the closest point on a Bezier curve.

methods.name: isCurve
methods.description: Checks if a value is a Bezier curve.

methods.name: curveTangent
methods.description: Calculates the tangent vector of a Bezier curve at parameter t.

methods.name: curveCatmullRomQuadraticApproxPoints
methods.description: Generates quadratic approximation points for a Catmull-Rom spline.

methods.name: curveCatmullRomCubicApproxPoints
methods.description: Generates cubic approximation curves for a Catmull-Rom spline.

methods.name: curveOffsetPoints
methods.description: Generates offset points along a Bezier curve.

methods.name: offsetPointsForQuadraticBezier
methods.description: Generates offset points for a quadratic Bezier curve.

methods.name: curveLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of a Bezier curve using Legendre-Gauss quadrature.

methods.name: curveLengthAtParameter
methods.description: Calculates the length of a Bezier curve from t=0 to a given parameter t.

methods.name: curvePointAtLength
methods.description: Finds a point on the curve at a specific percentage of total length using binary search.
